title: Millimeter Emission Structure in the First ALMA Image of the AU Mic Debris Disk
question: What is the millimeter emission structure of the AU Mic debris disk at 0.6" resolution, including the outer belt profile and a newly seen central peak?

data.angular_resolution: synthesized beam 0.80" x 0.69" (8x7 AU), p.a. 49 deg for SB-4

what.value: NextGen stellar model photosphere (Teff=3720 K, L=0.11 Lsun) giving F*=52 uJy at 1.3 mm, fitted to 0.4–25 um photometry

evidence.quote:
A NextGen stellar model (cite: hau99) with $T_{\rm eff} = 
3720$ K, $L_{\ast} = 0.11$ L$_{\odot}$, and $M_{\ast} = 0.6$ M$_{\odot}$ (cite: met05; che05)

external_data.citation: Hauschildt et al. 1999 (cite: hau99); Metchev 2005; Chen 2005

what.value: Astrosilicate opacity composition used for dust

evidence.quote: We calculated various $\kappa_{\nu}$ for dust with the (cite: wei01) “astrosilicate” composition

recipe.method: Calibrate each SB in CASA; natural-weighted MFS CLEAN image at 235 GHz; average central 112 channels per baseband and reweight

recipe.goal: Fit parametric belt + central Gaussian model to visibilities
recipe.method: Edge-on thin axisymmetric belt with power-law intensity plus circular Gaussian central source, fitted directly in visibilities for four basebands

recipe.goal: Estimate dust mass and temperature of central peak and outer belt
recipe.method: Optically thin dust emission F = kappa B(T) M / d^2 with astrosilicate opacity, n(a)∝a^-3.5, amin=0.2 um, amax 1 um–1 cm; max T constrained by IR SED
key_parameters: kappa = 2.7 cm^2/g; outer belt T ≈ 25 K
assumptions: d = 9.91 pc; central peak is star plus dust

evidence.quote: It is unresolved, with $\mathcal{R_{\rm cen}} \le 3.0$ AU (3 $\sigma$)
The corresponding minimum $M_{\rm dust}$ is $\sim$$9 \times 10^{23}$ g, about 1% of the lunar mass.
the dust mass of this outer belt is $7 \times 10^{25}$ g (cite: liu04b)
The best-fit model has a reduced $\chi^2 = 1.37$

not_stated_but_needed: Flagging details and line/edge channels excluded beyond 'central 112 channels'
Cell size, image size, CLEAN mask and threshold
Number of walkers and burn-in/convergence criteria
Dust temperature adopted when computing belt mass from the 7.14 mJy flux in detail
score_reason: Public Cycle 0 data and a clear model description with a table of results, but no code, and imaging and MCMC details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data are an ALMA Cycle 0 project (public per archive link), the model is described, and results are numeric, though public status is not stated in the paper.
